text:
maria: FYI — BigCorp flagged the upcoming model rotation: they want an explicit rollback window + migration credits if we force-sunset their v1 pin. Asking for a formal playbook.
aj: Can you paste the customer ask? exact wording matters for legal.
maria: "We need a 30-day rollback option and a one-time credit to cover re-testing/perf validation if v1 is deprecated." — from their CSM email.
sam: 30 days is large but doable as a temporary soft-pin. We'll need to lock their route to a compatibility shim or maintain v1 binary for that period. Cost hits ops.
lee: Options: 1) soft-pin + compatibility shim for 30d, 2) grace credits + incentivized cutover (reduced price for 60d), 3) custom SLA (reserved capacity) to guarantee latency. Which direction does sales prefer? @nina-sales?
nina-sales: Sales prefers option 2 (credits) if we can keep it bounded. Customer is enterprise, good NRR. They'd accept a 14-day hard rollback + 30-day grace credits if we offer migration help.
sam: 14d hard rollback + 30d credits seems reasonable tradeoff: engineering maintains v1 for 14d in hot standby, after 14d we decommission but offer credits if they request re-validation assistance within 30d. That removes indefinite ops burden.
aj: Need precise launch criteria for the cutover: metric thresholds for quality regression, perf delta, and a rollback runbook. Suggest: 
- quality: eval suite pass rate >= 98% vs baseline on customer prompts
- latency: p95 <= baseline + 20ms
- cost delta per 1M tokens < 15%
We'll also need an opt-in form & signed addendum for credits.
maria: Agree. Can someone draft the customer-facing snippet and internal playbook? We also need a tracking tag in the catalog: `gracepath: bigcorp-5129` in the model entry.
lee: I'll add the catalog flag. sam can you own the standby binary and rollback script? Deploy-bot will help with canary.
sam: I can own standby + rollback. I'll propose a minimal runbook: 
```
rollback.sh --tenant bigcorp --target v1
check-health --route bigcorp
promote-canary --duration 2h
```
We need a quick smoke test set from the customer though.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary-group=bigcorp, version=v2.5, window=2h. Use `--soft-safeguard` for automatic revert on >5% errors.
maria: Nina — can you confirm credit numbers and legal check on addendum? Also request a small prompt set from BigCorp for the eval gate.
nina-sales: Will do. I'll ask for the test prompts and propose credit = $X (TBD) + migration engineering hours.
aj: Once we have prompts, eng will run the benchmark and post results to this thread. If pass, product will publish the deprecation date + gracepath in the catalog.
maria: Thanks. Quick todo:
- nina: customer confirmation and prompts (ETA 24h)
- lee: catalog flag & comm blurb
- sam: standby binary + rollback script
- aj: launch criteria doc + legal addendum draft
I'll follow up with a short internal doc and tag this as a scoped pilot. :thumbsup:
lee: noted. I'll create a short runbook and a `catalog-gracepaths.md` snippet under internal docs.
sam: I'll post the smoke test results here when ready.
maria: If anyone objects to the 14d hard rollback + 30d credits, speak now. Otherwise proceeding to draft comms.
